en: Prof. Juniper
Hello again, {player}! I thought you might come this way.
Bianca
Hee hee! I used Fly, so it looks like I beat you here. Thanks for your help in Reversal Mountain!
Prof. Juniper
If you go straight on past Lacunosa Town, you'll come to Opelucid City! But before you go, there's something I want you two to hear.
Bianca
What is it?
Prof. Juniper
You'll see soon enough. Hurry along now!
This is the place!
{rival}
Team Plasma could be anywhere. Keep your eyes open, {player}.
{rival}
{player}! What's up? Have you seen Team Plasma anywhere around here? I heard a rumour that they were about.
Zinzolin
Oh, for crying out loud... How troublesome, my curious young Trainers.
Perhaps I should satisfy your curiosity a little. The reason I'm still part of Team Plasma is simple: I want to know how the world will change.
What Lord Ghetsis wanted is gone. What he was searching for, though, is still out there. And I intend to find it.
{rival}
Shut your mouth! All I want is to get back a stolen Pokémon!
{player}! Give me a hand! You ready?
{rival}
Are you ready to pitch in? Let's take them on together!
Just so you know... you're about to feel my rage!
Grunt
What's with these two? I'm fighting alongside Zinzolin! This shouldn't be happening!
Zinzolin
These Trainers remind me of a certain child from two years ago.
More importantly, we must continue the search. As that scientist said, it might be in Opelucid City! We shall play with you again later!
{rival}
Get back here!
Got it! Go and get ready, and then come back here! Being careful against opponents like these is no bad thing!
Storyteller
Do you want to hear that old tale of Lacunosa Town again? It always takes me a little time to tell.
Oh, fine, fine. Come back when you have time.
